We completely understand your situation and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and uncertainty this may be causing you.

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide you with an exact date at this stage, as the refund is currently pending approval from the management. We truly appreciate your patience and understanding while we follow up with the concerned team.
